title: Staff Software Engineer, Security Foundations
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

**An Overview Of This Role**
As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll help lead two important areas for GitLab Security: the data layer behind our vulnerability and dependency management capabilities, and our move toward services outside the GitLab monolith. You'll design and develop systems that ingest, store, index, and query security report data, including integrations with key third-party systems. With a strong focus on PostgreSQL and scalable backend design, your work will support security features delivered by teams across GitLab.
  
  
You'll take ownership of large deliverables from early ideas through implementation, working directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to shape the technical and product roadmap. You'll stay hands-on across GitLab's Ruby on Rails application and newer services, including greenfield projects, while helping the team build its expertise in modular service design.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead large technical deliverables from initial problem definition through delivery, often across multiple months or quarters.
* Design and develop backend systems for vulnerability and dependency management, including security report ingestion, storage, indexing, querying, and integrations with key third-party systems.
* Build and improve systems using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, and contribute to newer services using technologies such as Go or Rust where appropriate.
* Shape technical plans, break down complex work, and help other engineers deliver effectively.
* Work directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to make clear decisions, resolve constraints, and deliver measurable progress.
* Influence the team's product and technical roadmap through hands-on investigation, clear proposals, and iterative delivery that demonstrates progress in each monthly release cycle.
* Apply a security mindset when designing systems, including considering how GitLab identifies and handles malicious or vulnerable software packages.
* Define patterns for modular services, provide technical leadership when vulnerability management work spans multiple GitLab areas, and share that expertise across GitLab Security.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Experience leading complex backend projects from idea through delivery while remaining hands-on with design and development.
* Strong PostgreSQL experience, including evidence of query optimization, table optimization, and write-ahead log management in data-intensive systems.
* Strong professional experience with Ruby on Rails or Go and comfort working in Ruby on Rails day to day. Experience with large monoliths is helpful, along with an interest in working across languages and services.
* Experience shaping delivery plans, guiding technical decisions, and supporting the work of other engineers.
* The ability to collaborate with a range of partners and explain technical trade-offs clearly.
* Experience communicating with leaders, leading peers through complex delivery, identifying constraints, and moving work forward.
* Experience using security tooling for activities such as vulnerability triage and remediation, or professional experience building vulnerability management, dependency management, or related security products.
* Experience with large-scale data systems or established software products. We welcome transferable experience from outside the security domain.
* Fluency in using artificial intelligence tools to improve delivery while applying sound engineering judgment.

**About The Team**
The Vulnerability Management team contributes to GitLab's move toward modular services and will help other Security teams adopt these patterns over time. Today, we include two Staff Software Engineers, two Senior Software Engineers, and one Intermediate Software Engineer across the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, and India. You'll work closely with us, product partners, and engineering leaders across GitLab.
  
  
We work with clear goals and shared priorities. You'll receive clear context and outcomes, then have the space to own delivery, communicate decisions and progress, ask for help early, and work directly with the partners needed to get the job done.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. * Monitor and troubleshoot the systems you build, investigate failures and data mismatches, and respond to urgent issues.
* Design for retries, duplicate prevention, logging, alerts, and recovery; verify outcomes in connected systems.
* Test and manage releases, document changes, and maintain clear documentation of purpose, architecture, configuration, and support.
* Protect credentials and sensitive information, and communicate incidents, progress, risks, and decisions clearly.

* Technical depth and judgment to investigate problems, simplify processes, and deliver maintainable solutions at a practical pace.
* Initiative and clear communication: comfortable working directly with business leaders, documenting work, sharing progress, and asking useful questions.
* Ability to manage work independently in a remote environment with working-hours overlap with Eastern Time.

**Preferred Experience**

* HubSpot workflows and CRM data; Supabase; and n8n experience.
* Experience integrating multiple business systems, including CRMs, databases, communication tools, and third-party applications.
* Experience with other automation platforms, such as Zapier, Make, or HubSpot workflows.
* Experience with business intelligence (BI) tools.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Business teams have useful agents and automations that address understood needs and are adopted in their work.
* The specialist identifies opportunities, proposes practical solutions, and independently delivers agreed priorities.
* Production systems are monitored, documented, and maintained, with issues communicated and resolved.

* Department leaders and the technology team understand progress, decisions, and next steps.

* Hands-on ownership of AI agents and automation across business teams.
* Direct collaboration with department leaders and the opportunity to improve how the business works.
* A team that values initiative, clear communication, technical depth, and practical solutions.

Now I'm looking for a technical co-founder who can take complete ownership of technology while I focus on business, growth, partnerships and fundraising.

* Lead the development of our mobile applications and backend infrastructure.

title: SRE Engineer
description:
Role Overview
  
  
The selected SRE and DevOps professional will be responsible for maintaining highly available production systems, managing cloud infrastructure, improving observability, and supporting reliable deployment and operations practices. The role combines hands-on engineering with incident response, infrastructure automation, performance optimization, and continuous reliability improvement.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have experience working in production-critical environments where system availability, quick incident resolution, effective monitoring, and preventive engineering are essential.
  
  
Key Responsibilities1. Site Reliability and Production Operations
  
  

* Monitor production systems and maintain service availability, performance, and operational stability.
* Participate in production support and scheduled on-call rotations, including the resolution of critical incidents.
* Investigate system failures, perform root cause analysis, document post-incident findings, and implement preventive measures.
* Identify recurring operational issues and reduce manual intervention through automation.
* Improve service reliability using measurable indicators, service objectives, availability targets, and error-budget practices.
* Contribute to capacity planning, disaster recovery, high availability, redundancy, and failover strategies.
* Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering
* Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Work with cloud compute, storage, networking, access management, monitoring, and cloud-native services.
* Support containerized applications and manage Kubernetes-based infrastructure, including AKS, EKS, GKE, or equivalent platforms.
* Troubleshoot cluster health, application workloads, resource utilization, scaling, networking, and deployment-related issues.
* Work with Helm and other relevant deployment tools to maintain consistent application releases.
* Infrastructure Automation and DevOps
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
* Support automated infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and repeatable deployment processes.
* Work with Git-based development workflows, including GitHub, GitLab, Azure Repos, or equivalent platforms.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and improve deployment reliability through automation.
* Develop scripts using Python and/or Bash to simplify operational activities and eliminate repetitive tasks.
* Monitoring, Observability and Performance
* Build and maintain monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting solutions for production environments.
* Work with observability platforms such as OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, Golden Signals(including Latency, errors, traffic, saturation), AWS CloudWatch, and GCP Cloud Monitoring.
* Apply the four Golden Signals—latency, traffic, errors, and saturation—to monitor service health and identify performance issues.
* Improve distributed tracing and establish meaningful alerts that reflect actual system health and user impact.
* Investigate performance bottlenecks across infrastructure, applications, networks, and distributed systems.
* Linux, Networking and Security
* Troubleshoot Linux-based systems and production infrastructure issues.
* Apply networking fundamentals, including DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, SSL/TLS, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Follow cloud security best practices for identity and access management, network segmentation, and secrets management.
* Support vulnerability remediation, security improvements, and compliance-related activities in collaboration with relevant teams.

Technical Environment
  
  
The role involves cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, Terraform, scripting, production support, monitoring, and modern reliability engineering practices. Experience with one major cloud platform is important, while exposure to multiple cloud environments can be beneficial.
  
  
Additional exposure to Go (Golang), OpenSearch, ELK Stack, AI/ML production platforms, Azure AI services, AI Foundry, RAG-based workloads, and enterprise observability frameworks would be advantageous.

description:
**Scope**

* This role is focused on supporting various Blue Yonder Planning solutions in enterprise supply planning.
* Needs to work with cross functional teams including Product Development, Consulting and Cloud services.
* This role needs technical and non-technical support during the Steady state period. Provides primary user support and verifies that the system provides the required business functions and maintains data integrity.
* This position may require 24x7/Weekend coverage and response to systems alerts during 'on-call' periods.
* Provides advice to customers regarding industry best practices and process methodology.

title: Data Science Intern
description:
DATA SCIENCE INTERN

Company: Devryxa

Location: Remote

Duration: 3 Months

Employment Type: Full-Time Internship

Stipend: Performance-Based, up to ₹7,500/-

FOR COLLEGE STUDENTS ONLY

Devryxa is offering a structured Career Launch Internship Program designed to help students gain practical project experience, mentorship, and industry exposure.

The program includes guided learning resources, real-world projects, project evaluations, internship certification, and performance-based learning opportunities.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Devryxa provides students and graduates with practical exposure to data science and emerging technologies. The organization focuses on developing real-world technical and analytical skills through hands-on projects, mentorship, and industry-oriented learning experiences.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Data Science Intern, you will assist in analyzing datasets, developing data-driven solutions, and applying statistical and machine learning techniques to practical problems.

The role will provide practical exposure to data preprocessing, exploratory analysis, model development, evaluation, and visualization.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Collect, clean, and preprocess datasets for analysis

• Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns and trends

• Assist in developing and testing machine learning models

• Apply basic statistical and analytical techniques to datasets

• Create visualizations to communicate data-driven findings

• Evaluate model performance and document results

• Assist in preparing reports and project presentations

• Research relevant data science techniques and tools

• Collaborate with team members on practical data science projects

ELIGIBILITY

• Currently pursuing or recently graduated in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field

• Strong interest in data science, analytics, and machine learning

• Willingness to learn and work on practical projects

REQUIRED SKILLS

• Basic knowledge of Python

• Understanding of statistics and data analysis concepts

• Familiarity with Pandas, NumPy, or similar libraries is preferred

• Basic understanding of machine learning concepts is preferred

• Good analytical and problem-solving skills

• Good communication and teamwork skills

PERKS & BENEFITS

• Internship Certificate

• Letter of Recommendation based on performance

• Swags and Goodies

• Opportunity to work on real-world data science projects

• Practical industry exposure and mentorship

• Performance-based stipend up to ₹7,500/-

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

Devryxa is an equal opportunity organization committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and encourage students with a passion for learning and professional growth to apply.
